Usage: tadx capability <verb> [flags]

Shared:
  --config <path> --json --full (details, not rows)

Commands:
  get <id>: Inspect one capability's availability and contract
    ID: from capability list.

  list: List capabilities
    [--domain <domain>] [--limit <1..10000> (default: 20)] [--mutation] [--owner <owner>]
    [--product <product>] [--resource <resource>]
    Filters: AND, case-insensitive; product: substring, others: exact.
    --mutation=true: remote writes; --mutation=false: others; omitted: both.

Rules:
  Booleans: =true|false (bare=true); ... means repeatable.
